name: Kalyvox
tagline: Kalyvox is an AI voice agent for SMEs that handles inbound calls in real time
description: Kalyvox is an AI voice agent for SMEs that handles inbound calls in real time. It answers calls, captures intent, urgency, and context, and turns each interaction into a structured, actionable summary ready for follow-up. The focus is on making calls usable. Instead of relying on voicemails or partial notes, each call is converted into clear information that can be processed quickly.
